behavior: Four indexed public methods cover borrowed/moved InsertBefore/InsertAfter with signed/usize insertion indices and independently checked source indices.
Native source references keep their original physical slot through descending shifts. Final assignment reads that possibly changed slot; no eager clone or detached staging copy is made.
Example pinned native behavior: InsertBefore(0,array[1]) on10,20,30,40 yields10,10,20,30,40 because shifting changes the source slot before copying.

When source and final target coincide, a dedicated caller-supplied self-assignment callback receives one mutable reference. Native copy-self and move-self traces are preserved without constructing aliased Rust references.

Disjoint slot borrowing is shared by existing swaps, descending shifts and final internal assignments. No unsafe production code was added; original sort/reverse/insertion cases also pass strict Miri.

64 native matrix rows span four operations and every insertion/source position in a four-item array.12 additional rows cover default, shifting, final copy/move, self-assignment failures and native target-bound checks.

Callbacks observe the native committed size through resulting failure state. Completed mutations persist on unwind, source payload addresses remain stable, and no copy or move construction of an internal donor is substituted for assignment.

All54 earlier native rows remain byte-identical.17 new integration cases include four16-row matrix tests,12 failure cases and checked invalid sources; one unit covers same/different-block pair orders and self-swap.
limitations: Callbacks must implement the ported native item copy/move/self-assignment behavior and leave Rust values valid on unwind; automatic C++ capability selection and exception/noexcept ABI are not inferred.
Source indices address initialized logical items. Invalid native source references, hidden Rust-only initialized tails and native undefined behavior are not claimed.
Internal SetValue source aliasing remains open; EraseLast metadata count-update phase remains a separate identified gap.
Descriptor byte-layout and generic payload ABI proof are unchanged; observations are bounded to the pinned native/Rust configurations.
validation_scope: Normal, strict Miri, fmt and Clippy ran after final Rust source/test edits. Compiler captures unique body-bearing public methods. Native probe compares130 rows total against unmodified pinned headers via a verified generated forwarding include. Scoped archive accompanies committed base history; no shared parity ledger edits.
